name: Website Ventures Production Line v2
goal: Pre-plan every valuable Higgsfield/AI generation before paid production so one subscription sprint produces reusable website and Gamenfy assets instead of isolated pretty outputs.
hardRules: No paid generation without an asset ID, exact destination slot and acceptance criterion.
Create master still/reference first; animate only approved masters.
One coherent world/character beats many unrelated variants.
Use reusable Elements for recurring characters, environments and props after their reference image is approved.
Website proof remains real-source-only; AI demo imagery may never masquerade as completed client work.
Gamenfy public/private membership comes from live app data, never from concept art.
Existing approved Park 3.1 evolution art is preserved; new spend targets animation, props, environments and missing higher-level systems rather than recreating 130 existing WebPs.
Draft cheaply/fast where possible, then spend premium credits only on selected masters.
Archive prompt, model, references, crop, score, defects and final app/site usage for every attempt.

productionStages.name: Slot lock
productionStages.output: asset ID + destination + aspect ratio + acceptance gate

productionStages.name: Consistency test
productionStages.output: same character/object/world in one second context

productionStages.name: Cutout/sprite prep
productionStages.output: transparent PNG/WebP or game-ready sprite sheet

modelMatrix.task: Website master technician / realistic recurring person
modelMatrix.primary: Higgsfield Soul 2.0 or Cinema Studio Image 2.5
modelMatrix.production: Lock one winning portrait, then create reusable Element; subsequent stills via Element-compatible Nano Banana Pro / Cinema Studio Image 2.5 / Seedream 4.5.
modelMatrix.reason: Strong realistic/editorial person creation followed by explicit identity reuse.
Cinematic 4K composition first; Nano Banana Pro when text-space/crop/instruction fidelity matters more.
Instruction-based editing; Seedream 5 Pro can also remove backgrounds.

modelMatrix.fallback: Image Background Remover after Nano Banana Pro
modelMatrix.reason: Build reusable isolated objects rather than baking props into scenes.
Outputs game-ready sprite sheet from one approved character image; preserves app-native animation workflow better than embedding video.

modelMatrix.fallback: Short Seedance 2.0 loop + background removal where sprite output fails
modelMatrix.reason: Allows flame, leaf, water, sparkle or object motions to remain reusable game assets.
Seedance for reference/identity consistency; Cinema Studio only for selected hero payoff.

modelMatrix.task: Motion transfer from a reference performance
modelMatrix.reason: Useful only when a specific walk/gesture/camera motion is already approved and should be transferred.
Use only after a source clip is working and one prop/product needs swapping; not a first-generation workflow.
Final polish only; never upscale rejected work.

websiteBatches.name: Premium Plumbing identity + world lock
websiteBatches.definitionOfDone: One master technician Element candidate and one approved visual-world board that both pass consistency/credibility checks.

assets.input: text brief only for first candidate; winner becomes Element
assets.masterModel: Cinema Studio Image 2.5 or Nano Banana Pro
assets.gate: Same identity can be reproduced in second pose; authentic tradesperson; no fashion-model look; usable hands/workwear.
assets.next: Create Higgsfield Element only after winner.

assets.gate: Premium but credible in Dutch local-service context; text areas remain calm; red is accent not discount aesthetic.

assets.input: modern realistic Dutch service van, clean generic deep-red branding zones, no fake plate/company claims
assets.gate: Plausible commercial van; brand panel editable; perspective usable; no malformed wheels/text.

assets.input: compact realistic plumbing toolkit: adjustable wrench, grips, fitting tools, inspection light, protective cloth/case
assets.gate: Every tool physically plausible and recognizable; no fantasy tools.

websiteBatches.name: Premium Plumbing critical story stills
websiteBatches.definitionOfDone: Six coherent stills make the urgency→trust story understandable without motion.

assets.input: approved bathroom world; controlled obvious leak; no technician required
assets.gate: Problem understood <2 sec; premium; large stable headline/CTA negative space; no catastrophic flood.
Reads in 1–2 seconds; generic/no fake phone UI; same lighting/world.

assets.model: Nano Banana Pro or Cinema Studio Image 2.5
assets.gate: Same face/workwear; realistic Dutch residential context; vehicle geometry sound.
Natural crouch/inspection; believable tool orientation; calm competence.
Hands/tools/fittings believable; organized work area; no sparks/construction theatrics.
Space visibly dry/neat; service promise visible without cheesy thumbs-up.
Clear relief/result; clean CTA space; no invented testimonial/customer claim.

websiteBatches.name: Reusable support system
websiteBatches.definitionOfDone: Website can be adapted to real prospects without re-generating the whole art direction.

assets.model: Cinema Studio Image 2.5 / Nano Banana Pro
assets.gate: Chrome/water/fittings/tools all believable and from same material world.
Emergency is no longer the only story; every shown service remains generic until mapped to a real client's offer.

assets.model: GPT Image 2 or OpenAI Hazel only for visual concept; final should be coded UI
assets.gate: Frame enhances real photos but never generates the evidence itself.
Prospect can instantly understand desktop/mobile transformation; company-specific facts remain editable.

websiteBatches.name: Motion only after still gates
websiteBatches.definitionOfDone: Motion improves comprehension/premium feel and remains optional progressive enhancement.

assets.gate: Subtle water/reflection/camera drift; headline region stable; first frame already sells.
Identity/hands/tools stay consistent; natural speed; no music-video camera moves.

assets.model: Cinema Studio Video or Seedance 2.0 Mini
assets.gate: Seamless light/water movement and lightweight enough to justify use.

gamenfyStrategy.existingInventory: Park 3.1 already has 13 evolution sets x 10 levels = 130 committed WebPs. Do not recreate these by default.
gamenfyStrategy.assetArchitecture: Separate character, prop, environment and FX layers so CSS/JS can combine/reuse them instead of embedding everything in a single video.
gamenfyStrategy.preferredGameFormat: transparent PNG/WebP for static props; AutoSprite PNG sprite sheets for movement; video only for rare hero/background moments where sprite/CSS cannot achieve the effect.

gamenfyBatches.name: Core park object kit
gamenfyBatches.definitionOfDone: One coherent reusable park kit can decorate Daily Score, Park 3.1 and future skill scenes without being baked into character art.

assets.use: Daily Score walker + future park backgrounds
assets.gate: Bright premium-cartoon world; clear path; layers leave room for characters/UI; no embedded text.
Tileable/extendable; character feet can make convincing contact.
Same art language; distinct silhouettes; no baked ground rectangle.
Correct perspective and seat depth for character interaction.
Works unlit and lit; no surrounding background halo unless separate FX.
Blank readable face so real app text remains HTML/CSS, not AI-generated.
Static base usable without animation; water FX separable.

gamenfyBatches.name: Daily Score / walking system
gamenfyBatches.definitionOfDone: The current D-score can be visually replaced by a character that genuinely walks through a reusable environment and responds to score/health state.

assets.input: reuse an approved compatible Gamenfy character rather than inventing a new species unless required
assets.model: existing art + optional Nano Banana edit
assets.gate: Recognizable at small mobile size; neutral pose suitable for sprite animation.
Feet contact stable; no body morphing; loop seam invisible at app size.
Subtle breathing/weight shift only; recognizably same character.
Short celebratory effect; never blocks UI; can be disabled for reduced motion.

assets.model: CSS-first; AI only for texture object if needed
assets.gate: Motivating not punishing; does not distort health meaning.

assets.gate: Can show before/after cleanliness while existing character stays unchanged.
Does not modify approved panda art.
No baked writing required.
Positive but not childish clutter.

gamenfyBatches.name: Private quest + skill props
gamenfyBatches.privacy: personal; must stay out of public asset grid when applicable
gamenfyBatches.definitionOfDone: Existing private/skill characters can receive strong interactions without confusing Daily Mission membership.

assets.gate: Only private/PIN surface.
Private only; dramatic at low level but does not cover controls.
The word HELP remains real HTML/CSS or deterministic graphic, not unreliable generated text.
Correct racket/ball geometry; reusable independent of character.

recommendedSubscriptionSprintOrder: 1. Do zero-spend prep: confirm all asset IDs, final app/site slots and crops.
2. Produce PL-CHAR-001 candidates and lock exactly one master technician.
3. Produce PL-STYLE-001 + service-van/tool props; create Elements only for approved references.
4. Produce Plumbing critical stills WEB-B; score and reject aggressively.
5. In parallel, create Gamenfy Core Park object kit GF-A using transparent cutouts.
6. Use an existing approved Gamenfy character to test AutoSprite walk + idle before producing many sprites.
7. If AutoSprite test passes in-app, batch GF-C Daily Mission props and selected custom FX.
8. Produce Website support pack WEB-C after the core story works.
9. Animate only selected Website stills and selected Gamenfy interactions; motion is the last spend category.
10. Upscale/compress/export winners, integrate into repo, run mobile/performance QA, then archive exact prompts/models/references in the Vault.
stopConditions: If recurring identity changes materially between two stills, stop story generation and fix the reference/Element workflow.
If a transparent object still needs manual cleanup in more than two variants, switch model or use deterministic SVG/CSS instead of burning credits.
If AutoSprite produces morphing feet/body at app scale, do not batch more characters until the source character or frame settings are fixed.
If a motion clip is not clearly better than the still after compression/mobile playback, keep the still and save credits.
If a generated object embeds essential text, recreate the text in HTML/CSS and treat the generated object as decorative only.
